title: Prevent a completion focus turn from leaving its owner silently idle
outcome: A workflow that must end a turn for completion accounting has a durable, recoverable next action: its correct owner resumes through normal admission after accounting, or receives a bounded actionable stalled-state alert, without weakening focus, claim or completion checks.
acceptance: Both Engram recovery paths, EndTurnReadAndRetry and CaptureRootAndEvaluate, give vendor-neutral guidance to arrange and verify a durable host continuation before a deliberate focus/accounting yield, then reread the intended run. Guidance truthfully covers absent host capability and failed/unknown registration, does not invent a host operation or promise a source report, and is consistent across CLI, MCP, acceptance documentation and agent usage guidance. A missing acknowledgement means unknown registration state: reconcile the same idempotent intent with bounded retries and a recorded, actionable coordinator escalation on exhaustion; never claim an automatic wake is armed without confirmation.

Repository tests cover both remedy paths and preserve their typed causes, source/claim/evidence freshness enforcement and distinction between registration acknowledgement, checkpoint outcome and source confirmation. The changes introduce no scheduler, automatic claim renewal, completion bypass or new source-accounting producer.

Holder notes contain the agreed ownership/design split, both projects' concurrence, review resolution, precise linked TermAl acceptance and landed/build evidence. Host queue/crash/Stop/delivery/deadline tests remain in the TermAl implementation items and are quoted with attributable evidence/artifact locators for this item's evaluator; absent or partial evidence is explicit. Quote the source item, full note/artifact locator and landed hash for each host result, rather than asking the evaluator to follow a bare cross-project reference.

After the linked host capabilities are available, an attributed end-to-end evidence note records the target item/run, trigger turn, build/source identity, acknowledgement/outcome and subsequent authoritative read for (a) an explicitly registered focus-only completion yield and (b) the reported unregistered idle-claim case. Each resumes safely or produces the agreed durable actionable alert within its bound without a manual nudge; a wake/alert alone is never counted as test, source confirmation or completed work. The root remains open while either outage case lacks proof. The evidence quotes a numeric bound agreed on the TermAl item and observed timestamps for comparison; any narrowed coverage requires an explicit scope decision and disclosure through Advisor, never an implicit pass.
